title: The Final Demonstration of the Xerox 'Star' computer
summary: A Computer History Museum recording of the final demonstration of the Xerox Star, the early graphical user interface workstation. It is a long demo session that shows the design thinking behind desktop, icons and windows.
why: HN people point to it as a primary-source look at Star's interface design, especially its philosophy of fewer commands without fewer functions.

quote.text: Star had many fewer commands than today's systems, and it didn't do it by having fewer functions; it just had fewer commands .
